status_write_qualification: Normal nonEgg HP writer reaches Pokemon.hp=0 first; it directly heal_status→persistentNONE/count0 and clears ready_to_evolve before formalFaint. If later formalFaint is stopped by scene/other callbacks, that earlier persistent heal already remains.

Reached formalFaint: local status=NONE clears Truant/Toxic as defined then localNONE before calling bound Pokemon.status=. Ordinary persistentHP0 causes Pokemon.status= earlyreturn with no fresh registry lookup/status assignment; an atypical persistent-able bound individual instead accepts validatedNONE. The two memory objects are not universally synchronized by private/debug/raw mutations.

Battler status=NONE next invokes count=0 (because neitherPOISON norSLEEP): local count0 and bound Pokemon.statusCount0, refresh; then status setter refresh; then Faint explicit count=0 writes/refreshes again. Three refresh requests only if all prior callbacks return normally, not a guarantee three actual GUI draws.

If first count-refresh fails, local/persistent count0 remains but status outer refresh and Faint explicit count0 are unreached. If Pokemon.status= fails on an atypical receiver, localNONE/prefixTruantToxic can remain before count0. No transaction/rollback or completed save/reload.

manual_meaning: Wild wrapper generates once, conditionally triggers every registered on_calling handler with same Pokemon/reference [nil] box, immediately returns any nonnil handled[0] includingfalse; normal unhandled core return reaches conditional end hook then !=2&&!=5 boolean normalization.

Three actual override handlers each first refuse an already nonnil box: Roam requires global roamEncounter and nonnil roamer index; Safari requires actual inProgress and reception/map-safari gate; Bug requires contest inProgress. Returned override value is assigned only after that helper returns, not upon entering it.

Roam helper can replace/create actual stored roaming Pokemon (and can regenerate from input Pokemon species/form ID); calls direct WildCore with single/roamerFlees rules, then updates caught marker only1/4 and state cleanup/end hook before normal boolean. Safari helper returns numeric decision after ball state/stat/variable/end hook; Bug helper records start status, uses its own Battle, post-battle and ball state, outcome/end then boolean. Generic wrapper does not renormalize these already-handled return values.

Trainer wrapper waiting merge/probe and core flows retain actual source-defined conditions; ordinary core start/gen/setup/prepare→animation/standby/start→after→Input→Stats/variable ordering. Current intro and actual UI finite receiver support presentation only on normally returned dependencies.
recursive_remaining_outside_this_asserti: Full alternate battle mechanics, roaming route/state/resource selection and all native/map callbacks remain separate foreign scopes; these inventory assertions promise wrapper/redirect interfaces only.

meaning: Complete registerPartner resolves type then cancels vehicles, pbLoadTrainer(type,name,tr_id), triggers load event, replaces each member Owner from created trainer/calc_stats, then writes [type,rawname,trainer.id,trainer.party]. Deregister setsnil. Vehicle clearing can precede load failure; registry assignment is last, so nil trainer/Owner/stat errors do not guarantee it.

Registration third input is data version but stored third field is created trainer.id, not its version; current setup passes that stored id as later data-query version for partner items. This documented WP24 boundary is retained and not invented into a new finding.

Partner_can_participate checks registration/noPartner, accepts >1 foe before single-size veto otherwise uses explicit size notsingle/not1v; setup binds partner side owner1, shares individuals in merged new party and defaultsdouble only size nil. Command loop normally sends !player-owned battler to AI unlesscontrolPlayer forces interactive handling; same battle/owner context is actual whole AI001/Command source.

pbLoadTrainer resolves TrainerType.try_get then registered triple Trainer.try_get; unknown type raises before trainer query, absent triple returnsnil. meaning: Under actual probe conditions, wrapper first calls Trainer.generate_foes on data A; valid returned singleA with <=MAX_PARTY_SIZE is stored with current eventid in waiting and false returned. Complete loader/triple/new trainer source supplies exact new identity/items/party behavior above.

Later wrapper with waiting appends original A object; core checks skip/start first and parses freshB data with its own load event, while A hits NPCTrainer branch and is pushed/reused without another load or load event. Earlier A mutation from reached runtime handler therefore survives by identity.

pbLoadTrainer resolves TrainerType.try_get then registered triple Trainer.try_get; unknown type raises before trainer query, absent triple returnsnil. Trainer own try_get validates type Symbol/String and name String, converts type toSymbol, uses version exactly as supplied (includingnil) as third array key; it does not normalize nil to0.

to_trainer resolves localized/rival override name, NPCTrainer(name,type,@version), then random foreign trainer.id, clones stored item array and assigns localized lose_text. Each party Pokemon is a new individual with canonical Species.species, raw level and trainerOwner; it is pushed before optional form/item/moves/ability/gender/nature/IV/EV/shadow/finalstats. Failure after push can leave a partly built local trainer, but failed pbLoadTrainer does not return it into parser result.

Actual default literal source on_trainer_load registration example is commented, not an executable handler; EventHandlers dispatch still remains real and may have runtime registered handlers under separate scope. Ordinary source assertions condition on reached handlers returning, never infer all possible callbacks cannot mutate trainer/items/party.

meaning: Array type/name/version values are passed as-is to complete LoadTrainer; missing result calls MissingTrainer then retries only after normal return; no result after retry raises before load hook/collection. A pending previous type makes this array fail before loading.

MissingTrainer first validates/resolves type; nonDEBUG raises immediately, so no retry then. DEBUG asks Yes/No/Backdefault2; onlycmd0 calls complete NewTrainer with save_changestrue; other choices returncmd and parser still retries, which may remainnil→raise.

NewTrainer selects up toMAX_PARTY individuals (firstspecies cancel prompts again, later cancelbreaks); save stage constructs triple-id hash, registers new data in memory, calls Trainer.save then PBS conversion then message. Save/convert/UI error can leave registeredDATA but prevent fallback return/retry; no transaction or persistence-success guarantee.

On returned trainer hook executes before nonempty optional lose_text override and before collector appends trainer/items/start/party. Default absent hook is not assumed as universal runtime no-mutation.

pbLoadTrainer resolves TrainerType.try_get then registered triple Trainer.try_get; unknown type raises before trainer query, absent triple returnsnil. Trainer own try_get validates type Symbol/String and name String, converts type toSymbol, uses version exactly as supplied (includingnil) as third array key; it does not normalize nil to0.

to_trainer resolves localized/rival override name, NPCTrainer(name,type,@version), then random foreign trainer.id, clones stored item array and assigns localized lose_text. Each party Pokemon is a new individual with canonical Species.species, raw level and trainerOwner; it is pushed before optional form/item/moves/ability/gender/nature/IV/EV/shadow/finalstats. Failure after push can leave a partly built local trainer, but failed pbLoadTrainer does not return it into parser result.

Actual default literal source on_trainer_load registration example is commented, not an executable handler; EventHandlers dispatch still remains real and may have runtime registered handlers under separate scope. Ordinary source assertions condition on reached handlers returning, never infer all possible callbacks cannot mutate trainer/items/party.

meaning: Registration complete field/Owner chain is above; setup constructs freshNPCTrainer(name,type) defaultversion0, sets registeredid/party, queries data by [registeredtype,registeredrawname,registeredid] exact. Missing data gives fresh[], found data.items.clone means independent array with shared item values; no forced match to original tr_id/version.

Merged party newarray pushes player individuals then partner individuals; starts records player current length. Current $player.party later insert/delete may detach from merged collection while individual references still shared; actual terminal capture/restoration already fully finite-bound.

Only size nil addsdouble; no all nonnil rule normalization. Behavior identity/order contract does not impose future object/array representation. Existing WP24 correct identity-version boundary not reopened.

pbLoadTrainer resolves TrainerType.try_get then registered triple Trainer.try_get; unknown type raises before trainer query, absent triple returnsnil. Trainer own try_get validates type Symbol/String and name String, converts type toSymbol, uses version exactly as supplied (includingnil) as third array key; it does not normalize nil to0.

to_trainer resolves localized/rival override name, NPCTrainer(name,type,@version), then random foreign trainer.id, clones stored item array and assigns localized lose_text. Each party Pokemon is a new individual with canonical Species.species, raw level and trainerOwner; it is pushed before optional form/item/moves/ability/gender/nature/IV/EV/shadow/finalstats. Failure after push can leave a partly built local trainer, but failed pbLoadTrainer does not return it into parser result.

Actual default literal source on_trainer_load registration example is commented, not an executable handler; EventHandlers dispatch still remains real and may have runtime registered handlers under separate scope. Ordinary source assertions condition on reached handlers returning, never infer all possible callbacks cannot mutate trainer/items/party.
